name: Anjana Nandanam Veeram
text:
अञ्जनानन्दनं वीरं जानकीशोकनाशनम् ।
कपीशमक्षहन्तारं वन्दे लङ्काभयङ्करम् ॥
meaning: I bow to the brave son of Anjana, who ended Sita’s sorrow, the lord of the monkeys, slayer of Aksha, the terror of Lanka.
purpose: A praise of Hanuman as the brave son of Anjana and remover of Sita’s sorrow.
supports: Courage on behalf of others; loyalty.
